findings.verdict: c = 12 does NOT survive its own anchorage — the realised factor at the design point is 7.36, not 12 — but the CAP does survive the desired stroke. Because rho = k_far r/EI carries the ARM, the cap is a fixed point rather than a formula evaluated at an asserted c: 13.43 nm on the adopted duplex-end anchorage and 10.97 nm even about the CHORD, both above the 10 nm desired stroke, while a ONE-link anchorage collapses to the cantilever's 9.77 nm and fails it.
findings.whatHoldsTheArm: The arm's far end is a duplex END, so C-0029's counting theorem applies to it verbatim: two strand termini, lever arm at most the phosphate radius, and a couple 2k_bond,theta + 2k_bond,s a^2 = 78.24 pN nm/rad about the chord's perpendicular bisector against 13.53 about the chord itself. A SINGLY nicked continuation of a tile duplex is stiffer (683 pN nm/rad) and is the motif that matches the guided kinematics, because a nick PRESERVES the helix axis — which is exactly what 'guided' means.
findings.theSeriesQuestion: The anchorage IS in series with the hinge and the arm, and the sign is not the one the composition assumes. C-0023's 1/k = r^2/(n k_theta) + r^3/(c EI) is EXACT when the far end carries no moment and WRONG when it does, because a guide carries part of the end moment and RELIEVES the hinge: at the adopted design the series reading retains only 0.726 of the true stiffness, and at C-0029's asserted ideal guide only 0.607. So c = 12 and that composition cannot both be right.
findings.theAxis: The arm bends about the axis normal to the chord's plane, and the chord is a diameter of the arm's own cross-section — so the designer CHOOSES the axis with the helical phase, quantised at 33.74 deg per base pair. The worst misalignment is half a quantum and costs 7.0 % of the couple, leaving a ceiling of 13.32 nm. This is the OPPOSITE of the standoff: C-0029's column buckles about the axis the chord leaves free, but E5's arm carries no axial compression at all, so the free axis is unloaded.
findings.theDesign: E5a16 — a 11.03 nm = 32 bp arm on 16 crossovers, its far end a two-terminus duplex-end anchorage: realised c = 7.36, secant 33.3333 pN/nm at 3 nm, tangent 33.56 at 3 nm and 36.78 at 10 nm inside C-0023's 40 pN/nm ceiling, turning 20.9 deg at the desired stroke, 1.83 pN on a hinge crossover against the 10 pN unzip allowable, and its own anchorage demanding 7.3 bp of bonded length at the desired stroke.
findings.whatMovedFromC0029: C-0029's E5g16 is a 12.24 nm arm at c = 12; the realised design is 11.03 nm at c = 7.36 — 9.9 % shorter — because two errors run opposite ways: the realised end condition is softer than asserted, and the series composition the arm was solved with is itself the soft reading. The verdict does not move: the arm still exceeds the 10 nm stroke and the tangent still lands inside the ceiling.
findings.thePlacementBracket: Solved on the boundary-value problem instead of the series composition, the same 16-crossover flexure on the same realised anchorage places at 12.50 nm — against 11.03 nm from the large-rotation series reading and C-0029's 12.24 nm at an asserted c = 12. The three bracket the arm at 11.03–12.50 nm (32–37 bp), every reading clears the 10 nm stroke, and every reading sits below the ideal guide's 15.50 nm cap. Two errors run opposite ways and very nearly cancel — which is why C-0029's verdict survives an assertion that does not.
findings.theChallenge: C-0029's E5g16 cannot be placed at the mandate on its own c = 12. Read as the two-spring beam that c = 12 describes, a 12.242 nm arm on 16 crossovers with a guided far end assembles to 54.61 pN/nm — 1.64x the 33.3333 pN/nm mandate and past its own 40 pN/nm compliance ceiling at the SECANT, before any tangent is taken. The cause is not the anchorage but the composition: C-0023's series form is the free-far-end corner of the same BVP, and C-0029 changed c without changing the composition c belongs to.
findings.theDominantCompliance: Leaf A8.2's explicit ask, answered on the realised joint: the hinge carries 41.5 % of the path compliance and the ARM's own bending 58.5 %. C-0023 reported 92.5 % hinge for its one-crossover E5; at 16 crossovers and a realised anchorage the dominant term has changed sides.
